title: Campandgoslow Blue Lug Collection
content:
Bar tape and accessory company Campandgoslow has been working with Tokyo bike shop Blue Lug as a supplier of its handlebar tape for years, but this marks the two brands’ first collaboration. Within this drop is a Tool Roll, Duckbill Cap, Triangle Reflector, and a Half Messenger Bag that can be used as a basket bag.

Camp + Blue Lug: Tool Roll $58.00

The Blue Lug Tool Roll is perfect for keeping your bag organized. With two drop-in pockets and a zipper compartment for your small stuff, it’ll fit your coffee kit, repair kit or a couple Kit Kat bars. You can also strap it underneath your saddle for bagless adventures, but all you off-roaders may want to swap in a Volié strap.

  • 1000D Cordura with Great Horned Owl, Brown Trout or Western Rattler trim
  • 500D Cordura with Eastern Rattler
  • Folded: 6.5″ tall x 5.25″ wide, Unfolded: 6.5″ tall x 15″ wide
  • Drop-in and zippered pockets: 5″ tall x 4.25″ wide
  • Adjustable locking buckle
  • Made by Blue Lug in Japan

Camp + Blue Lug: Duckbill Cap $46.00

The five-panel Duckbill Cap is made from water-repellent, breathable nylon and trimmed with our custom woven tape. The caps are designed with a relaxed silhouette so they are comfortable for wearing or stuffing in your pocket. On the back end, there is an adjustable webbing strap with a low-profile buckle.

  • One-size-fits-most with a max of 25″ head (8 hat size)
  • Unstructured, packable brim, length 2.75″

Camp + Blue Lug: Triangle Reflector $14.00

Everyone’s familiar with Blue Lug’s iconic Triangle Reflectors. We just added a few little touches with a trim tape loop and a center fabric that matches the tool rolls and messenger bags. These small but mighty reflectors fit pretty much anywhere on your bag or bike.

Do not leave different colors face to face for a long time as the color may transfer.

  • 3.3″
  • Made by Blue Lug in Japan

Camp + Blue Lug: Half Messenger Bag $125.00

This pared-down half-size messenger bag works well for commutes and grocery runs. It also easily drops into a Wald 137 basket when you’re ready to get the weight off your back.

  • 1000D Cordura with Great Horned Owl, Brown Trout or Western Rattler trim
  • 500D Cordura with Eastern Rattler
  • Nylon upper, tarpaulin lining
  • 2 inner pockets, 12.25″ wide x 9.5″ tall x 6″deep, longest point of flap 19.5″
  • Strap is 1.5″ with a metal adjuster buckle
  • Velcro closure with straps for carrying bulkier, oversized loads
  • Made by Blue Lug in Japan

See more at Camp and Go Slow.
